name: Book Employee with Spouse — Happy Path
goal: User books an annual health checkup for themselves and their spouse, providing all valid information in the first attempt.
constraints: All user inputs are valid and accepted on first try. Spouse is over 18. Appointment date is valid and available.

phases.description: Bot presents booking option based on eligibility.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks 'Would you like to book an appointment?' and user selects 'Book an appointment'.

phases.description: Bot asks for coverage type and user selects 'Employee with Spouse'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot captures 'Employee with Spouse' as coverageType.

phases.description: User provides spouse name and valid DOB (over 18, past date).
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts spouse name and DOB in DD MMM YYYY format.
Bot accepts appointment date and validates it successfully.

phases.description: User provides valid mobile, state, city, and selects clinic from rich media.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms booking, thanks user, displays selected clinic name, and offers further help.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
